x: In the Youths 4 x 110 we only had three lads present and so could not field a team, while in the Junior 4 x 110 yards, our team of Kemp, Benstead, Laverick and Byrne could only finish 2nd to Mitcham A.C., the A.A.A.
A “ B ” team match held at Tooting on 3rd September was a four-club match with senior and junior events. Benstead and Laverick won their junior 100 yds., with C.
